      "options": [
        "outflow - inflow = net_supply (surplus positive, demand negative)",

      "evidence": "\"no negative shipments are allowed\"; \"The amount of supplies shipped on any route cannot exceed the maximum capacity\"",
      "options": [
        "NonNegativeReals",

        "Reals"
      ],

        0.85,
        0.1,
        0.05
      ],
      "majority_option": "NonNegativeReals"

      "decision": "capacity_constraint_direction",
      "evidence": "\"the amount of supplies shipped on any route cannot exceed the maximum capacity for that route\"",
      "options": [
        "x_ij <= capacity_ij",

        "x_ij = capacity_ij"
      ],
      "plausibility": [
        0.95,
        0.03,
        0.02
      ],
      "majority_option": "x_ij <= capacity_ij"
    },
    {
      "decision": "objective_definition",
      "evidence": "\"minimizing the total transportation cost\"; \"each route has a specific cost per unit of supply shipped\"",
      "options": [
        "minimize sum over arcs of cost_ij * x_ij",
        "minimize total units shipped (ignore costs)",
        "maximize total units shipped"
      ],
      "plausibility": [
        0.95,
        0.03,
        0.02
      ],
      "majority_option": "minimize sum over arcs of cost_ij * x_ij"
    },
    {
      "decision": "arc_orientation",
      "evidence": "\"From City 0: To City 1: Cost = 9, Capacity = 59\" (directed routes listed per origin)",
      "options": [
        "directed arcs as listed (x_ij only for listed from->to pairs)",
        "undirected edges with symmetric cost/capacity",
        "directed arcs plus reverse arcs with same cost/capacity"
      ],
      "plausibility": [
        0.85,
        0.1,
        0.05
      ],
      "majority_option": "directed arcs as listed (x_ij only for listed from->to pairs)"
    },
    {
      "decision": "nonnegativity_handling",
      "evidence": "\"All shipments must be non-negative\"",
      "options": [
        "variable domain NonNegativeReals only (no separate constraint)",
        "explicit x_ij >= 0 constraint in addition to domain",
        "lower bound -infinity with explicit x_ij >= 0 constraint"
      ],
      "plausibility": [
        0.6,
        0.35,
        0.05
      ],
      "majority_option": "explicit x_ij >= 0 constraint in addition to domain"
    }
  ]
